caseNameFull: Schenley Distillers, Inc. v. Bingler, District Director of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Elder W. Marshall for appellants. Solicitor General Rankin, Assistant Attorney General Rice, Hilbert P. Zarky and Melva M. Graney for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed. Mr. Justice Harlan took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
